in_hebrew.name: Bac
in_hebrew.meaning: שם נוצרי שפירושו Short form of Babacus, derived from Babas, meaning father.
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Bac הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. In Greek mythology, Bacchus was the god of wine, fertility, and ecstasy. His name is derived from the Greek word 'basko', meaning to shout or cry out, which may refer to the ecstatic frenzy experienced during Bacchic rituals. In Christianity, Bacchus is sometimes identified with Christ and associated with the Eucharist.
